title: Global geometrization of local smooth integral models in the Hitchin fibration for $\mathrm{GL}_n$: The Bass case
summary: In previous joint work, we proposed a new method to study local orbital integrals for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ (where $n=3$ or in the Bass case), by employing a smoothening method of a certain scheme defined over a henselian ring. In this paper, we geometrize this local smoothening method within the framework of the global Hitchin fibration for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ in the Bass case.
